fields.calculatedFormula:

    End_Date_SUN_Report__c = Start_Date_SUN_Report__c,
    TotalPrice,

    IF(
        OR(
            ISBLANK(End_Date_SUN_Report__c),
            ISBLANK(Start_Date_SUN_Report__c)
        ),
        TotalPrice,

        IF(
            Segment_Index__c = 1,

            IF(
                End_Date_SUN_Report__c = ADDMONTHS(Start_Date_SUN_Report__c, 12) - 1,
                TotalPrice,
                TotalPrice *
                (
                    365 /
                    (End_Date_SUN_Report__c - Start_Date_SUN_Report__c + 1)
                )
            ),
            0
        )
    )
)
